Hi Amanda — thanks for the clarity. Below is a compact delivery plan and attached artifacts; we can expand anything on request.

Summary of evidence included (attached):
- 20250620-qualys-credentialed-scan-summary.pdf — last full credentialed scan (redacted IPs).
- patch-manifest-20250623.csv — sample patch manifest with CVE IDs and remediation timestamps.
- cve-closure-ledger-2025Q2.xlsx — ledger entries showing triage -> remediation -> deploy.
- vm-cadence-onepager.pdf — short explanation mapping to SIG/CAIQ VM questions.
- attestation-draft-kpark-20250624.pdf — draft attestation for Head of Security signature.

Operational commitments (current operating policy):
- Scanning cadence:
  • Credentialed (external) scanning: weekly full scan (Qualys), ad-hoc full on major releases.
  • Unauthenticated web scans: nightly light pass.
  • Host agent telemetry: continuous; alerts into our ticketing system.
- Remediation SLA (typical targets):
  • Critical (active exploit / RCE): mitigation plan within 24 hours, remediation and deploy within 7 days where feasible; emergency hotpatch process available for customer-impacting findings.
  • High: triage within 48 hours, remediation target 14 days (exceptions handled case-by-case).
  • Medium: remediation window 90 days.
  • Low: routine next maintenance window.
- Exception handling: certain third-party library issues (licensed upstream) may have extended timelines; these are logged as Exception Tickets (example: TICKET-4521).

We will supply a signed attestation from Kimberly Park (Head of Security) once you confirm acceptance of the attached wording. I’ve also included a Drive link with the raw artifacts for your auditor to download.

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm the bundle meets the minimum SIG evidence requirements.
2) We will finalize and route the attestation to Kimberly for signature (expected same day if approved).
3) If you need token-level patch timestamps or a sample CVE rollback note, ask and we’ll export the filtered ledger.

Thanks — looping Monica and Marissa to confirm artifact locations and DocuSign routing.

— Dev
